{"code": "import networkx as nx

# Create a complete graph with 5 nodes
original_graph = nx.complete_graph(5)

# Create a copy of the graph
modified_graph = original_graph.copy()

# Convert node labels of the copy to start from 2
for node in modified_graph.nodes():
    modified_graph.nodes[node]['label'] = node + 2

# Add all edges from the copy to the original graph
original_graph.add_edges_from(modified_graph.edges())

# Find all k-clique communities in the resulting graph with k equal to 6

# Filter cliques to only include those with size 6
